Craftsmanship

From Sketch to Sunlight

Manufacturing

About the Collection

The Stone of Kept Sunlight

Citrine has always been the optimist among gemstones — the colour of late afternoon, of honey held to a window, of harvests and good fortune. The ancients carried it as a promise that warmth could be kept.

Reference 0705 is Star Jewellery's meditation on that promise: eighteen compositions in which golden, green and cognac citrines are given architecture, gardens and ribbons of diamond-lit gold to live in. It is a collection about light that stays.
